en.name: Tuna in a pouch
en.summary: An unopened retort pouch of tuna keeps 18 months from purchase in the cupboard. Once torn open it is a perishable ready-to-eat fish and keeps 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark, 18 months from purchase. A retort pouch is a can in a different shape: the sealed foil laminate is heat-processed exactly as a can is, which is why the tuna inside is shelf-stable and why the pouch is the thing to inspect. A pouch that has puffed up, is leaking at a seam, or has a pinhole or abrasion from rubbing against other packets goes in the bin unopened — the shorter shelf life compared with a can is largely because a flexible pouch is easier to damage. Do not store pouches loose in a drawer with tins.
en.fridge: Once opened, tuna from a pouch keeps 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, which is a little longer than an opened can because the fish is packed drier and there is no cut metal involved. Move the contents into a small covered container all the same — a torn pouch will not reseal and the surface dries out. This is ready-to-eat fish with no cooking step to fall back on, so keep it in the coldest part of the fridge, not the door, and do not leave it out for more than two hours, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for pouch tuna. Freezing it after opening is not recommended: the fish is already fully cooked and quite dry, and freezing leaves it woolly and watery on thawing. If you have more than you can eat within the fridge window, cook it into something — a fish cake, a pasta bake, a rice dish — and store that as a cooked dish rather than freezing the plain tuna.
spoilage: A puffed or swollen pouch, or one leaking at a seam.
A sour, ammonia-like or putrid smell when the pouch is opened.
Flesh that is mushy, slimy or grey-green.
Any pinhole, crease-crack or abrasion in the foil — discard it unopened.
tips: Store pouches flat and unsquashed; they damage more easily than cans.
Decant leftovers into a covered container — a torn pouch will not reseal.
Keep opened tuna on a cold shelf, not in the fridge door.
Buy the pouch size that matches a meal.

faq.q: How long does pouch tuna keep after opening?
faq.a: 3–4 days in a covered container in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: Why does a pouch keep less time than a can?
faq.a: The process is the same but a flexible foil pouch is far easier to puncture, crease or abrade, so the published unopened figure is shorter.

faq.q: Can you freeze tuna from a pouch?
faq.a: No timeline is published and it is not recommended. The cooked fish thaws woolly and watery — cook it into a dish instead.

zh.name: 鮪魚軟袋包
zh.summary: 未開封的鮪魚軟袋包從購買日起算放櫥櫃可放 18 個月。撕開之後它就是易腐的即食魚肉：4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光，自購買日起 18 個月。軟袋包（retort pouch）其實就是換了形狀的罐頭：密封的鋁箔複合袋和罐頭一樣經過加壓加熱殺菌，所以裡面的鮪魚才能常溫存放，而真正該檢查的也是那個袋子。袋身鼓起、接縫滲漏，或因為和其他包裝摩擦而出現針孔、磨損的，請不要打開直接丟——它的保存期之所以比罐頭短，很大一部分就是因為軟袋比較容易受傷。不要把軟袋包和罐頭一起亂丟在抽屜裡。
zh.fridge: 開封後，軟袋包鮪魚在 4 °C 以下可放 3～4 天，比開過的罐頭稍長一點，因為魚肉包裝時比較乾，也沒有切口金屬的問題。不過還是請把內容物換到小的加蓋容器——撕開的袋子封不回去，表面很快就乾掉。這是沒有後續加熱步驟的即食魚肉，所以請放在冰箱最冷的位置而不是門邊，離開冰箱不要超過兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時不要超過一小時。
zh.freezer: 軟袋包鮪魚沒有公布的冷凍期限，開封後也不建議冷凍：魚肉本來就已熟透且偏乾，冷凍後解凍只會又柴又出水。冷藏期限內吃不完的話，把它煮成一道菜——魚餅、焗烤麵、拌飯——再照那道熟食保存，比冷凍原味鮪魚合理得多。
spoilage: 撕開時聞到酸味、氨味或腐臭味。
魚肉軟爛、黏滑或呈灰綠色。
鋁箔上出現針孔、摺痕裂縫或磨損——不要打開，直接丟。
tips: 軟袋包平放、不要被壓，它比罐頭脆弱得多。
剩料換到加蓋容器，撕開的袋子封不回去。
開封後的鮪魚放冷藏層架，不要放門邊。
買與一餐份量相符的規格。

faq.q: 軟袋包鮪魚開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 換到加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。

faq.q: 為什麼軟袋包比罐頭短？
faq.a: 製程一樣，但軟性鋁箔袋更容易被戳破、摺裂或磨損，所以未開封的公布數字比較短。

faq.q: 軟袋包鮪魚可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有公布的期限，也不建議。熟魚解凍後又柴又出水，不如煮成一道菜再保存。
